text: With the same seeds (70-72) and 5-step checkpoints at e ceilings of 0.5, 0.6, 0.7 and 0.85, does raw layer-4 accel_step R2 stay near 0.87 up to e<=0.6 and then fall? If it does, the margin increase from e<=0.5 to e<=0.6 (about 0.15 to 0.19) comes entirely from the control R2 falling (about 0.74 to 0.68), not from better decoding.
